heroes.name: Amergin
heroes.title: Poet of the Landing
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. The bard who sang the land into accepting his people as they stepped ashore. When he chants, the hunt of the Otherworld rides. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Boudicca
heroes.title: Rebel Queen
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A queen who raised a whole country behind her chariot. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Ciar
heroes.title: Warden of the Mound
heroes.biography: Keeper of the road between the summer stone and the winter stone. Patrol in The Silver Branch, mission 7.

heroes.name: Corc
heroes.title: Raider of the Grey Sea
heroes.biography: A sea-raider who came with the mist and stayed for the plunder. Patrol in The Silver Branch, mission 4.

heroes.name: Cu Chulainn
heroes.title: Hound of Ulster
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A young champion whose battle-fury is legendary and whose speed is worse. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Deirdre
heroes.title: Sorrow & Resolve
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Foretold at her birth to bring sorrow, she learned the old words to answer the prophecy. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Dubhghall
heroes.title: The Withered King
heroes.biography: A king who swore himself to the dark half of the year and broke the silver branch so it would never end. Final opponent of The Silver Branch.

heroes.name: Fergus mac Roich
heroes.title: Exiled King of Ulster
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. A giant of a man who lost his throne by a trick and fought the war that followed on the other side. The keening women follow his host. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Fiachra
heroes.title: The Usurper of the Ford
heroes.biography: A chieftain who took the high seat in the long winter and keeps it with the Withered King’s help. Rival empire in The Silver Branch, mission 5.

heroes.name: Fionn mac Cumhaill
heroes.title: Leader of the Fianna
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. He tasted the salmon of knowledge once and has been hard to surprise ever since. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Medb
heroes.title: Queen of Connacht
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. She went to war over a bull so that her wealth would equal her husband’s, and her treasury has never stopped growing. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Orla
heroes.title: Druid of the Hazel Grove
heroes.biography: A druid of the hazel grove who keeps the calendar of fires. The hero of The Silver Branch.

heroes.name: Scathach
heroes.title: Warrior Teacher
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. She trained the best warriors of her age on an island of shadow and still takes students. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Tadhg the Grey
heroes.title: Champion of the Withered King
heroes.biography: The Withered King’s champion, who holds the stags’ wood. The Silver Branch, mission 6.

heroes.name: Ahmose
heroes.title: Liberator of the Two Lands
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. A young prince who took up his fallen father’s war and drove the foreign kings out of the delta. His jackal-masked guard marched at his side. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Ankhwen
heroes.title: Captain of the Drowned Barge
heroes.biography: A river captain who drowned in the first dark morning and came back hungry for orders. Patrol in The Twelfth Hour, mission 4.

heroes.name: Cleopatra
heroes.title: Diplomat & Strategist
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Speaks every language at her court and wins most battles before they begin. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Djedkhonsu
heroes.title: The Hollow Lector
heroes.biography: Once the highest reader of the House of Life, he learned the name of the coiled dark and bargained with it for an endless dusk to rule. Final opponent of The Twelfth Hour.

heroes.name: Hatshepsut
heroes.title: Visionary Pharaoh
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. She rules by planning, trade and patience, and her expeditions come home rich. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Hekaib
heroes.title: Sword of the Hollow Lector
heroes.biography: Djedkhonsu’s champion, who holds the rookery gate. The Twelfth Hour, mission 6.

heroes.name: Imhotep
heroes.title: Master Architect
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Builder, physician and scholar; the city was raised on his measurements. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Iti
heroes.title: Warden of the Horizon
heroes.biography: Keeper of the road between the two horizon-stones. Patrol in The Twelfth Hour, mission 7.

heroes.name: Nefertiti
heroes.title: Culture & Unity
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A queen of the sun-cult whose hymns steady armies and open sealed doors. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Paser
heroes.title: The Red Vizier
heroes.biography: A vizier who crowned himself in the dusk and calls Djedkhonsu his priest. Rival empire in The Twelfth Hour, mission 5.

heroes.name: Peseshet
heroes.title: Overseer of Physicians
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. She led the women physicians of the old kingdom and taught the midwives of Sais. Her words close wounds as surely as her needle. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Ramses
heroes.title: Conquering King
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A warrior-king who carves his victories in stone before the dust has settled. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Seshet
heroes.title: Lector of the House of Life
heroes.biography: A lector priestess of Abedju who reads the hymns that send the sun through the night. The hero of The Twelfth Hour.

heroes.name: Tiye
heroes.title: Great Royal Wife
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. A commoner’s daughter who became the most trusted voice at court; foreign kings wrote their letters to her. Cedar from distant ports arrives where she sends for it. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Achilles
heroes.title: Swift Champion
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Class assignment is provisional. The fastest spear of his generation, whose charge breaks a line before it has finished forming. Hireable in skirmish; not part of The Three Beacons.

heroes.name: Alexios
heroes.title: Strategos of Asterion
heroes.biography: The expedition commander sent to relight the three beacons of the Asterion coast. His command portrait, skills and artifacts persist through The Three Beacons.

heroes.name: Atalanta
heroes.title: Huntress of Arcadia
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Class assignment is provisional. Raised by the bears of Arcadia, she outruns every hunter and never misses the first shot. Hireable in skirmish; not part of The Three Beacons.

heroes.name: Heracles
heroes.title: Hero of Labors
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Class assignment is provisional. A son of Zeus who finished twelve impossible labours and still walks the roads looking for a thirteenth. Hireable in skirmish; not part of The Three Beacons.

heroes.name: Melas
heroes.title: Former Coastal Commander
heroes.biography: A former coastal commander who carried the great beacon’s lens to the storm plateau, believing one light should command the whole coast.

heroes.name: Odysseus
heroes.title: Cunning Voyager
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Class assignment is provisional. A king of a small rocky island who took ten years to sail home and outwitted everyone who tried to stop him. Hireable in skirmish; not part of The Three Beacons.

heroes.name: Perseus
heroes.title: Slayer of the Gorgon
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Class assignment is provisional. He cut off the Gorgon’s head with a borrowed sword and a polished shield, and keeps both close. Hireable in skirmish; not part of The Three Beacons.

heroes.name: Scout Captain
heroes.title: Plateau Patrol
heroes.biography: Leader of the patrol that sweeps the middle plateau between the first crossings and the ward gate.

heroes.name: Abe no Seimei
heroes.title: Master of Onmyō
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. The court’s greatest diviner, said to be the son of a fox-woman. Fox-fire answers him before he finishes the charm. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Akane
heroes.title: Diviner of the Western Shrine
heroes.biography: A shrine diviner who reads the lantern-smoke at the festival of the dead. The hero of The Lantern Road.

heroes.name: Benkei
heroes.title: Devoted Guardian
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A warrior-monk who once held a bridge alone and now holds armies together. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Gonryō
heroes.title: Captain of the Fog Fleet
heroes.biography: A sea captain whose ships sail out of the fog and never into port. Patrol in The Lantern Road, mission 4.

heroes.name: Hangaku Gozen
heroes.title: Archer of Torisaka
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. She held the walls of Torisaka from the gate-tower with her bow until an arrow found her. The river-folk of her northern home fight beside her. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Kagerō
heroes.title: Warden of the Last Torii
heroes.biography: A warden who walks the road between the sun stone and the moon stone. Patrol in The Lantern Road, mission 7.

heroes.name: Kurogane
heroes.title: The Iron Daimyo
heroes.biography: A lord who fences the wandering dead into his army and calls them loyal. Rival empire in The Lantern Road, mission 5.

heroes.name: Kusunoki Masashige
heroes.title: Loyal Defender
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. He held a mountain fortress with a few hundred men against an army, rolling logs and stones down on every assault. Walls rise wherever he camps. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Momotaro
heroes.title: People's Hero
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Born from a peach, raised by farmers, and followed by a dog, a monkey and a pheasant who all give advice. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Oboro
heroes.title: General of the Hazy Moon
heroes.biography: Yamikage’s general, who holds the kirin meadow’s gate. The Lantern Road, mission 6.

heroes.name: Tomoe Gozen
heroes.title: Legendary Archer
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A mounted warrior famed with bow and blade, first into every breach. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Yamato Takeru
heroes.title: Imperial Explorer
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A prince sent to every edge of the map, who keeps coming back from it. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Yamikage
heroes.title: The Lantern-Eater
heroes.biography: A spirit of the borderlands who learned to swallow light, and swallowed the lanterns of seven provinces. Final opponent of The Lantern Road.

heroes.name: Yoshitsune
heroes.title: Brilliant Strategist
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. Trained by mountain tengu; his marches arrive where no one expects them. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Acatl
heroes.title: Captain of the Lake Canoes
heroes.biography: A canoe captain who raids the lake towns in the Night-Knife’s name. Patrol in The New Fire, mission 4.

heroes.name: Chilam Balam
heroes.title: Jaguar Prophet
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. The jaguar-priest whose prophecies were copied for centuries. He reads the count of days and calls down black glass from the sky. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Eight Deer Jaguar Claw
heroes.title: Tactics & Divine Right
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A Mixtec lord whose campaigns fill whole painted books. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Hunahpu
heroes.title: Trickster & Resilience
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. One of the Hero Twins who outplayed the lords of the underworld at their own game. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Itzel
heroes.title: Day-Keeper of Xochitla
heroes.biography: A day-keeper who counts the calendar and knows which fire belongs to which day. The hero of The New Fire.

heroes.name: Itztli
heroes.title: The Night-Knife
heroes.biography: An obsidian priest who wants the age to end in darkness so that the next one will be his. Final opponent of The New Fire.

heroes.name: Lady Six Sky
heroes.title: Warrior Queen of Naranjo
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. She came to a broken city as a bride and ruled it as a conqueror, carved on its monuments standing on a captive. The beasts of the cenotes answer her. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Mazatl
heroes.title: Keeper of the Fire Mountain
heroes.biography: The Night-Knife’s champion, who holds the fire mountain. The New Fire, mission 6.

heroes.name: Moctezuma Ilhuicamina
heroes.title: Archer of the Sky
heroes.biography: Proposed hero. A ruler who built dikes across the lake and stone causeways into his city. Quarries work day and night under his stewards. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Nezahualcoyotl
heroes.title: Poet King & Harmony
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A ruler, engineer and poet whose aqueducts and verses both outlived him. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Tecuani
heroes.title: Lord of Itzcalli
heroes.biography: A city lord who swore to the Night-Knife in exchange for the next age’s throne. Rival empire in The New Fire, mission 5.

heroes.name: Tlacatl
heroes.title: Warden of the Smoking Gate
heroes.biography: Keeper of the road between the morning-star stone and the evening-star stone. Patrol in The New Fire, mission 7.

heroes.name: Topiltzin Quetzalcoatl
heroes.title: Reform & Enlightenment
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A priest-king who took the feathered serpent’s name and its teachings with it. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Xbalanque
heroes.title: Skill & Opportunity
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. The other Hero Twin, patient and exact, who finishes what his brother starts. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Barrow Captain
heroes.title: Warden of the Glacier Plateau
heroes.biography: The Grey Jarl’s oldest captain, who sweeps the plateau before the barrow-gate. Patrol in The Winter Oath, mission 7.

heroes.name: Bone-Helm
heroes.title: Captain of the Nail-ship
heroes.biography: Draugr captain of the ship of nails, who walks the frozen sound with his crew. Patrol in The Winter Oath, mission 4.

heroes.name: Brynhild
heroes.title: Valkyrie & Devotion
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A shieldmaiden bound by an oath she chose herself. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: The Grey Jarl
heroes.title: Barrow-king of the Long Winter
heroes.biography: Hrolf, a king of a thousand winters ago, swore to hold the winter under his mound in exchange for a kingdom when it ended. The winter never ended. Final opponent of The Winter Oath.

heroes.name: Hervor
heroes.title: Ancestral Power & Vengeance
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. She woke a grave to claim a sword; the runes have answered her since. The hero of The Winter Oath; hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Hrafn the Hollow
heroes.title: Oathless Einherjar
heroes.biography: Chosen by the Valkyries once, he walked out of their hall for the Grey Jarl’s promise of a war that never ends. Holds the Glacier Gate in The Winter Oath, mission 6.

heroes.name: Lagertha
heroes.title: Leadership & Resilience
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A war-leader who has never lost a retreat she ordered. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Ragnar
heroes.title: Conquest & Glory
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A raider-king who measures a season by the harbors that answer to him. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Sigurd
heroes.title: Dragonslayer & Destiny
heroes.biography: Concept-board hero. A wanderer who once stood against a wyrm and now leads others against worse. Hireable in skirmish.

heroes.name: Ulfhild
heroes.title: Jarl of Hvitstrand
heroes.biography: A living jarl who swore to keep the Grey Jarl’s winter for a frozen sea that keeps her rivals’ ships in harbour. Rival empire in The Winter Oath, mission 5.
